item.title: GAELS SWEEP MARAUDERS IN THREE SETS ON HOME COURT
item.description: The Queen's Gaels swept the McMaster Marauders in three thrilling sets on Friday night in the ARC. The Gaels were lead on offense by outside hitter Claire Carter (Business) who made 8 kills and 2 service aces. Setter Kennedy Millin (Education) directed the offense with 27 assists and 3 kills, an impressive feat for a setter. item.title: 2026 season ticket packages for defending Yates Cup champion Queen’s Football on sale NOW
item.description: Queen's Football is defending the Yates Cup in 2026; make sure you're along for the ride!

item.title: Causeway Clash: Queen’s and RMC commemorate 140-years of rivalry, in 2026 Carr-Harris Cup
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey and their crosstown rivals, the RMC Paladins, will clash on the ice for the second time this regular season on Saturday, Feb. 7. This time, however, the matchup moves beyond the historic confines of Memorial Centre and the close-quarters intensity of Constantine Arena to the bright lights of Slush Puppie Place downtown, and with a trophy in the building and citywide bragging rights on the line.

item.title: Gaels Come Up Short in 0-2 Loss to Concordia
item.description: The Queen's Gaels Men's Hockey team battled the Concordia Stingers on Friday, January 30, but fell 0-2 in a tightly contested matchup. Despite a strong effort and disciplined play, the Gaels were unable to fight back against Concordia's defensive performance.

item.title: Queen's Women's Hockey edge Ontario Tech in shootout
item.description: Mikayla Cranney and Taya Leonard scored in the shootout, and goalie Emma Tennant stopped two of three shooters to help lead Queen's Women's Hockey past the Ontario Tech Ridgebacks 2-1 Friday night in Oshawa, Ont.

item.title: Victory in Toronto: Queen’s Wins 75–68 Over TMU Bold.
item.description: Queen's Men's Basketball kicked off their road trip with a cross-division clash against the TMU Bold, riding a four-game winning streak into the matchup. The Gaels came out hot, jumping to an early 24–13 lead after the first quarter and setting the tone for the game.

item.title: GAELS SWEEP IN THREE THRILLING SETS AGAINST MARAUDERS AT HOME
item.description: The Queen's Gaels swept the McMaster Marauders in three sets on Friday night at home. The Gaels were led by outside hitter Nikola Mitrovic (Economics) who made 11 kills and 2 service aces, while Reed Venning (Arts & Science) contributed 10 kills. Setter Chris Zimmerman (Arts) orchestrated the offense with 30 assists, 1 service ace, and 1 kill.
